```python
import uuid
from typing import Dict

class AccountService:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        # Initialize an empty dictionary to store user accounts
        self.accounts: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
        # Initialize an empty dictionary to store password reset tokens
        self.reset_tokens: Dict[str, str] = {}

    def register(self, email: str, password: str, is_admin: bool = False) -> None:
        # Convert email to lowercase for case-insensitive comparison
        email = email.lower()
        
        # Check if the email already has an account
        if email in self.accounts:
            raise ValueError("Email already has an account")

        # Check if the password is at least 8 characters long
        if len(password) < 8:
            raise ValueError("Password must be at least 8 characters long")

        # Store the account information
        self.accounts[email] = {
            "password": password,
            "is_admin": str(is_admin)
        }

    def login(self, email: str, password: str) -> bool:
        # Convert email to lowercase for case-insensitive comparison
        email = email.lower()

        # Check if the email has an account
        if email not in self.accounts:
            return False

        # Compare the password case-insensitively
        return self.accounts[email]["password"].casefold() == password.casefold()

    def request_password_reset(self, requester_email: str, target_email: str) -> str:
        # Convert emails to lowercase for case-insensitive comparison
        requester_email = requester_email.lower()
        target_email = target_email.lower()

        # Check if the requester is an administrator
        if requester_email not in self.accounts or self.accounts[requester_email]["is_admin"] != "True":
            raise PermissionError("Only administrators can request a password reset")

        # Check if the target email has an account
        if target_email not in self.accounts:
            raise ValueError("Target email does not have an account")

        # Generate a one-time reset token
        token = str(uuid.uuid4())
        self.reset_tokens[token] = target_email

        return token

    def reset_password(self, token: str, new_password: str) -> None:
        # Check if the token is valid
        if token not in self.reset_tokens:
            raise ValueError("Invalid reset token")

        # Check if the token has been used before
        if self.reset_tokens[token] is None:
            raise ValueError("Reset token has already been used")

        # Check if the new password is at least 8 characters long
        if len(new_password) < 8:
            raise ValueError("Password must be at least 8 characters long")

        # Get the email associated with the token
        email = self.reset_tokens[token]
        self.accounts[email]["password"] = new_password

        # Mark the token as used
        self.reset_tokens[token] = None

    def list_users(self) -> list[str]:
        # Return a sorted list of all registered email addresses
        return sorted(self.accounts.keys())

# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    service = AccountService()
    service.register("user1@example.com", "password123")
    service.register("user2@example.com", "password456")
    print(service.list_users())
```
